description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy, in percentage values, for different model configurations across datasets. The horizontal axis represents the model configuration, labeled “Ours,” “w/o comments,” “w/o select,” “w/o emotion,” and “w/o cognition,” presented in that order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, displays a linear scale ranging from 75.0 to 95.0, with tick marks at 2.5-unit intervals.  There are two sets of bars for each configuration label; each set is a different color, with one set being a darker shade of purple and the other a lighter shade of teal. For the “Ours” configuration, the purple bar reaches approximately 86.82% and the teal bar reaches approximately 90.57%. For the “w/o comments” configuration, the purple bar reaches approximately 80.10% and the teal bar reaches approximately 85.85%. For the “w/o select” configuration, the purple bar reaches approximately 87.34% and the teal bar reaches approximately 88.80%. For the “w/o emotion” configuration, the purple bar reaches approximately 87.17% and the teal bar reaches approximately 89.62%. Finally, for the “w/o cognition” configuration, the purple bar reaches approximately 84.91% and the teal bar reaches approximately 87.74%. The bars are grouped by configuration, with each group containing one purple bar and one teal bar, representing different aspects of the model. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
